notes.title: Baklava Simulator V1.2 Update
notes.notes:
[u][b]Thief[/b][/u]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831344/aa7b6e577c8341fe8551655ca3b6ff5897fe382d.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831344/519d9c0a44e25124c5f27828fb2452776a25c974.png[/img][/url]

Thief Fixed, wage rate stabilized.

[u][b]Cargo Vehicle[/b][/u]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831344/29a24a8fa66bba14d032787bf10610f1349f073a.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831344/9935413e00c3576576d90410881ab5c6b73395ec.png[/img][/url]

Our cargo vehicle now delivers the products you give faster to your warehouse. 


[b][u]Customer[/u][/b]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831344/c74900094752c6c8ec0b6edc48ab877cf7578a1f.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831344/ee94432777bc09806a5836c33df355f42eb4988e.png[/img][/url]

After the popularity system is removed, you will get many more customers in your store.


[b][u]New Economic System[/u][/b]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831344/b9170acd51ad4a466ba91053c76aa8ef9bc30bc2.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831344/4b86a7117cf759e602e0698c6f6df36c2d5128ec.png[/img][/url]

A new economic system was introduced.


[u][b]Product Making Process[/b][/u]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831344/131d2064ed04e75a780713e7ba4b7e023366da78.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831344/dcc6de3cafb18e0503f205a696d41549b7864aba.png[/img][/url]

Dough kneading, dough rolling, baking, syrup and packaging times have been adjusted.

[u][b]QUEST[/b][/u]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831344/90f502198a3b40fcd2fec3914f51c2b0eeb5e6d5.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831344/0cf886abdaf85ddb698eab2fbb0f189ee3996174.png[/img][/url]

The new mission system now has a notification system that will guide you through each mission. Both visually and in writing.


[u][b]Voice[/b][/u]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831344/c41e9ada2de658bf36a9d7665e8f798d6bf467cf.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831344/fe716c4c041ae76c14786f8df241adc14ad352d0.png[/img][/url]

We are continuing our updates on in-game sounds and the next big update will be on sounds.


[u][b]Information[/b][/u]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831344/3cc5b60bcc5faf3b6c08831fb5a72d3c4f1a37b3.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831344/c200ebca34436ebbc49618261a1d3ede2644c855.png[/img][/url]

Please feel free to get back to me. Let us know your feedback and we will do our best to make the game better for you.

We wish you a good game.

notes.title: Baklava Simulator V1.1
notes.notes:
[u][b]GamePad Added.[/b][/u]
[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/690612046462582794/1213026928705937408/gamepad.jpg?ex=65f3fa5c&is=65e1855c&hm=449642c55c99741d06113ab139f0c97442c6bdc1efa86dabff028b2ad7ff2f9b&[/img]

Our game now supports the gamepad system, so you can play it easily. We wish you good games.

[u][b]Bug Fixed.[/b][/u]
[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/690612046462582794/1213027204632412190/bug-fixed.jpg?ex=65f3fa9e&is=65e1859e&hm=833d543a9a7186d2528bc8f46244655bc6208f219b5d0cb125bde08c1c6f844d&[/img]

[u][b]Optimization[/b][/u]
[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/690612046462582794/1213027691285057566/game-optimization.jpg?ex=65f3fb12&is=65e18612&hm=20dc984b6affc62986c1ebc5cba3981956659e91022b1caa8fbe797f47fde288&[/img]

We are moving our game even further with the feedback we receive from you, please do not hesitate to comment, you can join our discord channel and give us feedback. [u][b]We continue to update our game, new systems will be with you very soon.[/b][/u]
